headline: US Dollar holds near 19-month high on persistent interest rate hike bets
summary: The US dollar held steady near a 19-month high, supported by recent economic data and comments from Federal Reserve officials reinforcing expectations for elevated interest rates.
why: The US dollar is the global reserve currency; its appreciation tightens international financial conditions and pressures foreign currencies.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Economic resilience and Fed rhetoric supporting higher rates bolstered dollar strength.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: US economic data and hawkish Federal Reserve commentary spurred demand for the greenback.
